Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Alright,

A vampire with a title attempts to diablerize
a vampire in torpor and uses Daring the Dawn
so as not to be blocked.

Is the order of effects:
1. Diablerie occurs (with all steps as per rulebook)
2. Bloodhunt
3. Daring the dawn sends diablerist to torpor

or is it
1. Diablerie
2. Vampire does to torpor from Daring the dawn
3. Bloodhunt

The signifigance of course being that in the first situation the
diablerist can use their title to vote on their possible demise but
cannot in the second.

Thanks,
JTP

wrote:

>
>or is it
>1. Diablerie

>3. Bloodhunt
>

So by saying that when the first option occurs the bloodhunt occurs
before the action resolves? I thought the vote would automatically
occur after the diablerie was successful - henced resolved. So if that
was the case wouldn't the action modifier effect of Daring the dawn
occur immediately after the diablerie but before the next action. The
Bloodhunt is defined as a referendum in the rule book(6.5.6) and
automatically conducted after a diablerie.

I am also aware that the blood hunt isn't an action as it states so in
the rules. I'm not quite sure how that fits in but it is late here and
I just want to know if a bloodhunt is really the fourth step of
diablerie or not. :)

What do you guys think?
